lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Thunder in my chest, the midnight shakes
Pressure building, heaven calling, how much can I take?
Empty in the echo, shattered pride in my feet
Drag me through the ashes, grind, repeat
Raging in the city, tempters haunt every step Still I press toward the mercy I haven't earned yet
Battle scars show the wars I fought for love Bury the evil, resurrect what's above
Steal in my veins for the pain that demands Tear out the hate, let love come in
Inferno drops
Heartbeats colliding
Beating stabs
And the sound truth's not hiding
Let go the mask
Cut me free from my chains
Give up the crown
Let the Lord reign
Lighting up the night
Every beat testifies
Stand up, shout out
Hardcore, never compromise
Relentless pursuit, surrender is my choice
Up the shadows and the light, amplify my voice
Love half-hearted, no words left unsaid
Forgiveness runs deeper than the blood I've bled
Separate from the noise, walk His way
Sacrifice my flesh, know His glory
He stays under all the gospel
Sounded for the lost, defiant in the storm
Pay every cost, abide in his love
Don't stop, don't run, kingdom's coming
Let the darkness be undone
Happy finale, sky splitting apart
Burn me to bone, leave only his heart
Every lyric in bar, deeper than pain
Testify loud, yeah
Yeah, who's shoe was rain?
Bye.
